workflow: A caller constructs an executable object by modifying its captured-variable metadata and initialization instructions independently.
The modified metadata declares more captured variables than the initialization instruction supplies.
Execution begins and assumes the declaration and initialization count agree.
An internal consistency assertion detects the mismatch and terminates the process instead of rejecting the malformed executable object earlier.
summary: Inconsistent executable metadata triggers runtime assertion
decision_reason: The failure is materially the same as workflow-0102: externally constructed executable metadata violates internal layout/count invariants and reaches an internal validation assertion rather than producing a recoverable validation error.
